description: This file is an example script demonstrating the use of Delta robot API functions for motion, speed, acceleration, and timing. It sets motion parameters, performs various move commands, and includes timing functions, all in a hardware-agnostic, safe stub environment.

methods.name: WAIT
methods.description: Waits for a digital input or timeout.

methods.name: DELAY
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified duration.

methods.name: MovP
methods.description: Performs point-to-point motion to a predefined point.

methods.name: MovL
methods.description: Performs linear motion to a point.

methods.name: MovJ
methods.description: Moves a specific joint to a position.
